mentions.name: PushMe
mentions.description: PushMe is a notification service that sends alerts for anything the user cares about. It combines a crawling engine and de-duplication with LLM-generated custom keyword filters, and each event is checked against the original prompt with an LLM before being sent out, to avoid the false positives of plain keyword matching.
mentions.problem: The builder was wasting too much time scrolling news, and keyword-based alerts produce mostly false matches (381 of 388 potential matches failed verification).
mentions.audience: The comment describes a personal use case: the builder was wasting too much time scrolling news and wants notifications for anything they care about.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building PushMe: A service that sends you notifications for anything you care about.
